item.title: Man sentenced for sexually abusing two minors on Warm Springs Indian Reservation
item.description: Harold Charley, 39, was sentenced to 20 years in federal prison for sexually abusing two minors on the Warm Springs Indian Reservation.

item.title: Pediatric cancer research law 'opens the door' for Portland nonprofit's continued advocacy
item.description: Now that the Give Kids a Chance Act has been enacted, the Sam Day Foundation is ready to ramp up advocacy for cancer research.

item.title: Two injured, three detained after shooting at NE Portland motel
item.description: Four suspects were arrested after a man and woman were shot at a Northeast Portland motel, officials said.

item.title: Motorcyclist seriously injured in SE Portland crash
item.description: A motorcyclist suffered serious injuries in a crash involving a motorcycle and another vehicle in Southeast Portland's Centennial neighborhood early Friday afternoon, prompting an ongoing investigation and closure of the area.

item.title: 'Our house is on fire': Oregon Supreme Court ruling would drop over 1K criminal cases, prosecutors say
item.description: District attorneys estimated the decision will lead to the immediate dismissal of 1,465 cases statewide.

item.title: Portland leaders consider controversial move to use climate funding for Moda Center upgrade
item.description: Portland leaders are considering using up to $75 million from the city's Clean Energy Community Benefits Fund to help pay for renovations at the Moda Center, in order to keep the Trail Blazers in town.

item.title: Gresham family who were arrested after seeking care for 7-year-old child heading home from Texas, Rep. Dexter says
item.description: Democratic Congresswoman Maxine Dexter (OR-03) says she was denied entry to an immigration detention facility in Texas, where a Gresham family is being held following their arrest on their way to seek medical care for their seven-year-old child.

item.description: While some of the money was only recently identified, the memo states a portion of it was uncovered within the past several months.

item.title: VIDEO: Successful start to 2026 Portland Winter Light Festival
item.description: PORTLAND, Ore. (KOIN) -- The 11th annual Portland Winter Light Festival started off with a large turnout to downtown Portland.
